note: City of Nashua campground in Cedar View Park on a peninsula in Cedar Lake (the Cedar River impoundment above Nashua's dam); the loop follows the north shore, with sites on both sides of the campground road, and the park has a beach area and ballfields. --Claude
summary: Electric 50 -> 30 (city: '30 amp electricity at all RV sites'); booking reservable true -> false, fcfs always (self-register and pay on arrival; the 'reservable via city site' claim was wrong). Confirmed 43 RV + 5 tent sites, $25 (tents $15, monthly $600), showers/restroom/dump. Season left as recorded (no dates on the city page). Lakefront confirmed: the water is the ~500 m wide Lake Nashua impoundment of the Cedar River (OSM reservoir), not a river channel, and the pads on the lake side of the loop road sit ~5-15 m from the shore across open grass with no road between; the city advertises 'waterfront camp sites'. Above the dam, so the below-dam rule doesn't apply. Pin within ~70 m of the loop (fine).
